title: Replica count alone does not prove maintenance capacity
method: Synthetic tested capacity=3×40=120 requests/s; after one replica removal=2×40=80, below 90 demand by 10. Assumes equal capacity and no other bottleneck.
alt: Replica count alone does not prove maintenance capacity: Three replicas 120 requests/second, After one removal 80 requests/second, Required demand 90 requests/second. Illustrative inputs.
